nodes.label: Logo Glow Effect (604x604)
nodes.description: 604x604 RGBA decorative glow/halo effect in blue (~rgb(34,139,239)). 58.5% semi-transparent pixels forming a soft radial glow. Used as a decorative background element behind the app icon or logo in splash/loading screens.

edges.note: Blue glow effect visually complements the blue app icon
